description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter for presenting and interacting with a list of tasks in an Android application. It includes ViewHolder definitions, DiffUtil logic for efficient updates, and methods for binding data to UI elements.

classes.name: TaskAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of TaskEntity objects, handling item creation, binding, and efficient updates via DiffUtil.

classes.name: TaskViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to UI components for each task item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a TaskViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds task data to the ViewHolder UI components, including setting text and click listeners.
